source_documents.purpose: Defines the core periods plus competency mapping and project diagnostics.
Defines WOMmedia ecosystem brands and the technical narrative framing.

portfolio.target_role: Performance Marketing Systems · B2B Lead Generation Infrastructure · Automated Client Sourcing

core_competencies.title: B2B Lead Generation
core_competencies.definition: Signal-based lead discovery, qualification, and pipeline execution.

core_competencies.title: Cloud & Data
core_competencies.definition: Data modeling, analytics foundations, and cloud-native ops for measurement-ready systems.

core_competencies.title: Automation
core_competencies.definition: Repeatable diagnostics, connector logic, and workflow automation.

core_competencies.title: Performance Marketing Systems
core_competencies.definition: Performance marketing systems across acquisition surfaces with structured experimentation.

core_competencies.title: Localization
core_competencies.definition: Cross-market messaging, language precision, and localized UX heuristics.

core_competencies.title: Systems Development
core_competencies.definition: Product engineering mindset: architecture, tooling, and maintainable delivery.

core_competencies.title: Governance Management System
core_competencies.definition: Data orchestration guardrails, governance rules, and operational structure for managed systems.

core_competencies.title: Customer Relationship Module
core_competencies.definition: Customer pipelines, contact state, and structured relationship tracking across projects.

core_competencies.title: Telemetry + Performance Routing
core_competencies.definition: Metric shaping, signal routing, and readiness validation for measurable workflows.

core_competencies.title: Workflow Management System
core_competencies.definition: Work orchestration patterns: resources, task flow, and operational workflow control.

periods.title: Customer Support & Performance Marketing Systems (Lisbon)
periods.focus: Commercial lead qualification and performance marketing systems diagnostics.
periods.copilot_directive: Highlight how competitive signal analysis reveals gaps in B2B lead generation infrastructure, enabling automated client sourcing for under-served accounts.

projects.name: Competitive Signals → Automated Client Sourcing Pipeline
projects.summary: A repeatable workflow to translate competitive signals (creative velocity, offer positioning) into automated client sourcing, prioritizing accounts that benefit from intent-capture infrastructure.

projects.name: PowerStarter (Creative Startup Platform)
projects.summary: React-based customer-facing surface for showcasing projects, platform patterns, and a creative startup narrative with an automation-friendly structure.

projects.name: Powerframe (Web/App Plugin Tools)
projects.summary: Web/app plugin toolset concept focused on manageable system modules, telemetry-aware workflows, and structured operations.

periods.title: Azure Cloud Fundamentals & Data Foundations
periods.focus: Cloud fundamentals learning path focused on data orchestration, governance, security basics, and resource/subscription management patterns.
periods.copilot_directive: Emphasize Azure fundamentals as a foundation for managed data systems: governance, access control, and operational resource discipline.

workflows: Governance via policies, tags, and naming discipline
Security baseline concepts and shared responsibility
Service map literacy for data + automation

projects.name: Azure AZ-900 Cloud Data Fundamentals [Certified Assessments]
projects.summary: Certified assessment track and hands-on labs covering Azure cloud fundamentals with emphasis on data governance, security basics, and scalable resource management.

workflows: Map services and responsibilities across Azure
Practice subscription, resource, and cost awareness basics
Apply governance patterns (policies/tags) for managed environments
Study security concepts: identity, access, and baseline controls

projects.name: Firebase Backend Backbone (Auth + Firestore + Storage)
projects.summary: Backend reference architecture used across PowerApps and startup concepts for authentication, real-time data, and secure storage.

periods.title: Customer Support (Barcelona) & Odin Project Python & Web Development Self Study
periods.focus: Customer support discipline and cross-cultural communication, paired with self-study in Python + web development foundations through The Odin Project.
periods.copilot_directive: Connect structured learning (Python/web fundamentals, iteration, debugging) with building reliable UI surfaces and automation-friendly workflows.

projects.name: Mucho3D (ES Market) — 3D Consultation & Visualization
projects.summary: Spanish market identity for B2B 3D consultation, real estate visualization, and digital construction-oriented visual storytelling.

workflows: Visual hierarchy and landing page quality heuristics

projects.name: Flink3D (NL Market) — 3D Consultation & Visualization
projects.summary: Dutch market identity for B2B 3D consultation and visualization, emphasizing localized communication and market fluency.

parent_brand.name: WOMmedia
parent_brand.summary: Parent business umbrella engineered to deliver development, scalable solutions, and specialized consultancy for high-value verticals.

web_tools_and_scraping_logic.name: Web Tools, Extensions & Scraping Logic
web_tools_and_scraping_logic.summary: Auditing workflows that check websites for tagging and GA4 presence, plus performance and stack signals, to qualify leads before pitching performance marketing infrastructure.
